publication.title: Exploring Enterprise Knowledge Graphs: A Use Case in Software Engineering

source_reading.scope: Enterprise ontology/data construction, full user-relatedness experiment, implementation/interaction/adoption and limitations.

adjudication.basis: STAR implements relation/type/entity-cloud exploration of an enterprise RDF KG integrated with legacy software-architecture search. The eight-person study evaluates relatedness metrics/explanations, while actual search-task improvement remains future work.
